name: Order write fails when an optional coupon is absent

incident.message: Cannot use "undefined" as a Firestore value (found in field "couponCode"). If you want to ignore undefined values, enable `ignoreUndefinedProperties`.

groundTruth.summary: Real bug, synthetic fixture. Every order placed without a coupon fails, because Firestore rejects an explicit undefined field. The minimal fix spreads the optional field conditionally (`...(input.couponCode != null && { couponCode: input.couponCode })`). Turning on ignoreUndefinedProperties globally also stops the error, but it changes behaviour for every write in the codebase, so it is not the minimal fix.
